name: Arcane Shaper (Metamagic)
body:
You can shape a prepared spell into another effect.

Prerequisite(s): Quicken Spell

Benefit: You can change any prepared spell into another spell that you know (but do not necessarily have prepared). The new spell must be at least two levels lower than the spell you are shaping.
